summary: The radio answer-bank construction leaks the answer through option spacing. The shortcut succeeds on all 30 tested simple linear-root radios, including the actual batch radio, and three eligible stored questions. Mathematics, native grading, rendering and packaging checks passed.

source_analysis.skill: Differentiate square-root and reciprocal-square-root functions of linear or quadratic polynomials using the chain rule; in slope questions evaluate the derivative at a specified point.
reasoning_steps: Identify inner polynomial u and outer power 1/2 or -1/2.
Differentiate outer and inner functions separately and multiply.
Substitute the original polynomial and simplify.
For tangent-slope tasks, evaluate at the stated x; differentiate an added cubic separately when present.
invariants: Outer exponent is plus/minus one half; inner polynomial degree at most two in this KP.
Real differentiable evaluation points require positive radicand.
Derivative contains the inner derivative factor, including legitimate zero at a stationary point.
Preserve symbolic versus evaluated response and observed radio versus blank profiles.
One chain-rule application, plus the observed cubic derivative only for its source family.
permitted_variations: Small coefficients, signs, constants and evaluation points while maintaining valid domain and comparable arithmetic.
Positive, negative and zero slopes where inner polynomial permits them.
For fixed quadratic, change evaluation target and recompute all dependent solution and answer content.
Vary radio position and distractor values without a template cue identifying the answer.
An additive constant outside the radical can vary without changing the derivative; this is a mathematical counterfactual, not a required production extension.

lesson step 60f88dd0-c1bd-546f-9dac-f440401fd02b: e-182 uses u=1-x^2, dy/du=1/(2 sqrt(u)), du/dx=-2x.

decision_variation.details: Correctness follows relevant counterfactuals and is invariant to option shuffling, but coefficient-times-option-spacing bypasses differentiation. It succeeds 5/5 within each of six simple linear-root radio templates, 10/10 easy survivors, and 1/1 applicable actual-batch member. Three eligible stored radios reproduce the same weakness. Difficulty-first selection supplies no mitigating bank filter.

findings.description: The production scale_bank forces five consecutive multiples of the correct radical contribution divided by the visible coefficient a. For simple linear square-root radios, choose a times the common positive spacing; for reciprocal roots choose -a times it. This supplies the outer derivative and, for slopes, the target evaluation without doing either. Randomizing rank or displayed position does not remove the cue. The exact batch contains this defect in its single radio; its four blanks are not claimed bypassable by this strategy.
